definitions.explanation: The act of starting or founding a business. Also refers to the time when a business was first established.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧1920⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{創業|そうぎょう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{創業|そうぎょう}100⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}えた→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧⟦{老舗|しにせ}→老舗：16152_shinise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧だ。
examples.english: It is a long-established inn that has reached its 100th anniversary since founding.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧⟦{町工場|まちこうば}→町工場：26008_machikouba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{創業|そうぎょう}し、⟦やがて→やがて：03637_yagate⟧⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{知|し}られる→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{育|そだ}てた→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧。
examples.english: My father founded a small town factory and eventually grew it into a nationally known company.

notes:
Commonly seen on company websites and in business contexts. Japanese companies often proudly display their founding year, especially long-established ones. Distinguished from ⟦{設立|せつりつ}→設立：14171_setsuritsu⟧ (establishment), which often refers to the legal incorporation date, while {創業|そうぎょう} refers to when business operations actually began.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {創業|そうぎょう}{者|しゃ}: founder
- {創業|そうぎょう}100⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧: 100 years since founding
- {創業|そうぎょう}⟦{以来|いらい}→以来：01831_irai⟧: since the founding
